definitions: An individual thing or person regarded as single and complete but which can also form part of a larger whole.
A quantity chosen as a standard in terms of which other quantities may be expressed.
A self-contained section of a building or a group of buildings.
A small group of people who work together as part of a larger organization.
A piece of furniture or equipment that is designed to be part of a set or to perform a particular function.
examples: The family is the basic unit of society.
The metre is a unit of length.
They rented a small unit in the industrial park.
He was assigned to a special operations unit.
The kitchen has a built-in oven unit.
